title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S06 E11 — Forty Days to Fail or Fortune
A widowed Colorado mine owner and her foreman face a last stand to save her gold-rich, inherited claim; Freddy and Juan scramble with ingenious fixes and point them towards a pay streak before winter closes them out.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S06 E08 — Double Trouble
A familiar miner in Alaska desperately needs 150 ounces of gold to save their operation; when Juan learns that their landowner's mine is halfway to $1M in the hole, he and Gold Rush legend Dave Turin face their first-ever double rescue.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S04 E01 — Valley of Riches
The fate of a rookie mountain miner lies in the balance after he sinks his life savings into a British Columbia placer claim; with fine gold proving tricky to capture, Freddy and Juan must develop all-new ideas to boost recovery.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E03 — Avalanche Country
Competing companies team up to recover a fully loaded cement truck leaking natural gas; Big Jon heads into avalanche country to rescue a stuck semi carrying hazardous goods; during a sudden blizzard, a crash in Salt Lake City leaves a semi in pieces.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E05 — Ain't Worth Dying For
As a record-breaking windstorm hits Wyoming, recovery crews work side by side in hurricane-force winds to right rolled semis and clear the interstate; an icy path around Utah Lake overturns a loaded dump truck.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E03 — Diagnosing Rick
Rick receives a life-altering diagnosis; Greenhorns push Tony to his breaking point; Parker fires up a third plant and gets surprising gold results.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E04 — Keno City Conclave
Tony ambushes Rick with a secret offer; with high hopes, Parker's crew fires up a fourth plant in the Quagmire Cut; Buzz bets on White Channel pay.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E05 — Low-Grade Panic
Rick hires an engineer to see if he can mine again this season; Parker's crew struggles to keep four plants running; Tony tries to double his gold.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E06 — Rivers of Gold
Rick prospects new ground on Duncan Creek; Tony tasks Nick to deliver their biggest haul of the year; Buzz finds a feeder to increase production.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E07 — Black Gold
Parker buys a new plant to mine the promising Road Cut; Tony's crew runs bedrock to keep gold flowing; Greg and Buzz decode mysterious black pay dirt.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E06 — The Midnight Storm
Big Al's Towing races the clock as a semi carrying an expensive frozen load overturns on I-80.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S06 E10 — Desert Storm
Freddy and Juan face a failing dry mine in Arizona run by military veterans; when a monsoon wreaks havoc on the rescue, they create their first-ever pay dryer system to quadruple the gold yield.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S01 E01 — Last Chance Gold
After losing his job, Fred Dickinson enlists the help of Freddy and Juan to rescue his homemade operation, tap into one of Arizona's richest gold veins and provide for his young family of seven.

title: Gold Rush: White Water
description:
S09 E08 — Mutiny at Nugget Creek
Desperate to find gold and save his mining career, Dustin Hurt is ready to risk the lives of his entire crew by chasing gold at the bottom of a deadly waterfall; an all-out mutiny changes the course of his season.

title: Auction Kings
description:
S01 E06 — Iwo Jima Sword; Cathouse Chairs
The Gallery 63 team takes in two chairs that may have come from a New Orleans cat house and a 1969 Oldsmobile 442; a young soldier raising money for his wedding brings in a WWII Japanese rifle and sword.

title: Live to Farm
description:
S04 E07 — Watermelon Wide Open
Watermelon harvest brings fun, but who's up for the competition?; Kevin hosts his annual MACC consulting group field day.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description:
S03 E02 — The Secrets and Troubles of Cahawba
A Revolutionary leader visits Alabama's first capital and leaves it bankrupt; an Oregon fort refuses to engage an enemy submarine during World War II; a film studio in Jacksonville, Fla. caters to a new audience.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description:
S04 E05 — The Vermont Doomsday Gun
A research facility spawns new technology with earth-shattering implications; a coastal haven for African Americans changes the nation; a forgotten fortress fights off a Nazi submarine; a staunch building stands firm on San Francisco's darkest day.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description:
S03 E01 — The Cult of Antelope, Oregon
A rural town in Oregon is invaded by an eccentric cult, a battered building in Florida plays a major role in the cigar trade, and a junkyard palace in New Jersey becomes the subject of controversy and rumors of the supernatural.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description:
S04 E06 — Idaho's Atomic Ghost Town
The remains of Idaho's nuclear industry mark a new era of American history; a distillery in rural Kentucky revolutionizes liquor; a New England settlement prospers despite prejudice; subterranean chambers produce many of the nation's monuments.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S17 E07 — Chasing Civil War Gold
Josh hunts for missing Confederate gold, exploring a wagon train robbery site where stolen coins vanished; then, a fresh eyewitness lead points directly to Jefferson Davis's lost war chest.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S14 E04 — America's First Train Robbers
Josh tracks down the legend and treasure of an outlaw posse, who terrorized the Midwest's railroads; Josh tracks the Reno Gang's lost loot to a cave hideout that could hold millions.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S14 E06 — Dive for America's Pirate Loot
Josh braves the frigid, shark-infested waters off Cape Cod to dive the world's only confirmed pirate wreck; joining a high-tech recovery mission, Josh chases the multi-million-dollar treasure of Black Sam Bellamy, including coins, gold and jewels.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S17 E05 — Secrets of Mexico's Underworld
Josh joins archeologists as they bushwhack through thick jungles and rappel into vast caves in search of the lost Zoque culture.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S15 E02 — The Man-Eating Lions of Kenya
Josh braves the African savanna to investigate the rampage of two lions who killed as many as 135 railroad workers in 1898; to prevent more bloodshed, Josh joins wildlife rangers tracking a pair of rogue lions who are on a modern-day killing spree.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S17 E02 — There Will Be Blood
In an international tribes challenge, one survivalist must cope with menstruation in the middle of the African bush.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S17 E01 — Death by Crocodile
A hunter and a farmer pool their knowledge to survive 21 days in South Africa; when the African wildlife proves too stealthy to hunt, the survivalists take a life-threatening risk for food.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S18 E08 — Toxic Redemption
Four survivalists seek redemption for their past failures; however, their promises to make it through 21 days on a remote Philippine lake are put to the test when they accidentally ingest a toxic substance.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S18 E07 — Enter the Queen
"Naked and Afraid" legend Laura Zerra returns to mentor a blacksmith and a former MMA fighter as they attempt to survive 21 days in Yucatán; scant food resources, deadly crocodiles and violent storms shake their confidence.

description:
S06 E06 — Bonanza Creek Bounty
With added scenes and bonus features; Parker storms into Bolivia's gold belt to prospect virgin ground that could hold two million ounces of gold -- right where Butch Cassidy and The Sundance Kid roamed.

title: Gold Rush: Parker's Trail
description:
S06 E07 — The Dark Horse
Parker goes all-in and starts mining the 400-acre Bonanza Creek claim, but a chance encounter with neighboring miners could offer him something even better.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E06 — Up in Smoke
When their hillbilly scotch experiment flames out, Mark and Digger light a fire under their still hand, Kelly. Josh's lucrative 80-gallon moonshine order rides on Jerry's unproven vacuum still experiment. Mike devises a recipe to poach Jerry's buyer.

title: Jeff Dunham's the Cars That Drove Us
description:
S01 E04 — Corvette
Before becoming America's Sports Car, the Chevrolet Corvette was the bane of General Motors' existence.

title: Adventure Cities
description:
Tampa Bay, Fla.
Seasoned travel writer Jonathan Thompson explores the spirit that brings Tampa Bay to life -- from pirate cannons and flamenco dancing, to Cuban sandwiches, cigar rolling and thrilling roller coasters.

title: Guided: The Reel Story of Louisiana Guides
description:
S01 E02
Science, saltwater and sportsmen; our friends at Louisiana Wildlife and Fisheries take guided aboard the stingray -- the state's new saltwater electrofishing boat -- to show how cutting-edge science helps manage the fish that guides.

title: Tomorrow's World Today
description:
S10 E06 — Science & Supplements
George sends Greg to the World of Innovation to explore how one company is transforming the supplement industry through traceability, science-backed formulations and rigorous clinical research.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E04 — Who Let the Cons Out?
Convicts making last efforts to break free when their hands are tied; whether a crook on trial or an inmate with a corrections officer, handcuffs, cops and prison walls won't stop these guys from their escaping attempts.

title: Caught!
description:
Don't Mess With Mother Nature
A coast-to-coast adventure guided by Mother Nature; discovering America's diverse landscapes, mountains, and shorelines -- all while battling the elements and experiencing hilarious encounters with its wild creatures along the way.

title: Caught!
description:
Leave It to the Professionals
Amateurs attempt outrageous activities; hilarious stunts, spills, and thrills gone wrong showcase backyard engineering, clueless humans and uncooperative machinery.

title: Caught!
description:
Life in the Fast Lane
An adrenaline-fueled journey across the nation to dive into America's road adventures.

title: Caught!
description:
S01 E03 — Vacation Mayhem
Vacations create new experiences and memories that last a lifetime; every misadventure, from spring break smackdowns to terrible tourist fails.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E14 — Brawl in the Family
They say blood is thicker than water, but family can put one through the wringer; sibling squabbles, petty pranks and daring parental rescues.

title: Caught!
description:
The Friendly Skies
A compilation of hilarious clips from around the world featuring airborne comedy, including in-flight antics and unexpected encounters in the air.

title: Caught!
description:
S01 E14 — Wild on the Water
The open seas teem with mischief, patrolled by the U.S. Coast Guard and Marine Law Enforcement to ensure safety; officers leap to capture runaway boats, rescue families from dangerous waters, save ice anglers, and outsmart drug traffickers.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E02 — Dashcam Disasters
Dashcam use continues to rise, catching even more unbelievable vehicle events; semi-trucks wreak havoc on roadways; criminals flee cops in pursuit; crashes, collisions and cars flying through the air.

title: Caught!
description:
S01 E12 — Indecent and Exposed
Disorderly conduct ranges from public streaking to getting personal in public spaces; people can't seem to keep their passion private; an argument at a gas station leads one woman to an epic flip-out.

title: Caught!
description:
Walk on the Wild Side
Hilarious clips showing that everyone has a wild side; people recording some unexpected events.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E01 — Tased and Confused
Police takedowns can be risky business, especially when criminals are armed and dangerous; that's why officers rely on non-lethal tactics like tasers, bean bag rounds, and K-9 units to subdue suspects when things get a little too close for comfort.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description:
S01 E01 — Twister Shapeshifter
Near Gary, S.D., expert chasers and certified weather spotters self-shoot an encounter with a long-track, shape-shifting tornado; when the twister takes a turn towards an occupied farmhouse, chasers are thrust into the role of first responders.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description:
S01 E02 — Mile-Wide EF5
Six teams of chasers pursue a violent tornado outbreak in North Dakota; but as day turns to night, the storm unleashes the first EF5 tornado in over a decade; as the mile-wide monster levels homes and farms, chasers race to rescue people and pets.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description:
S01 E04 — Tornado Alley Weed Farm
Six teams of chasers brave Oklahoma back roads as a late spring warm front unleashes long-track tornadoes.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description:
S01 E03 — Danger Close in Dakota
Teams of expert storm chasers and certified weather spotters risk it all to venture into America's Tornado Alley; they self-shoot their encounters with nature at its most extreme, warn people in harm's way and help save lives when disaster strikes.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description:
S01 E05 — Spin City
While chasing a monster in Alabama, Sarah parts ways with Reed moments before he takes the Dominator for a spin inside a tornado.

Every year tornado junkies descend on America's tornado alley; these storm chasers put everything on the line to prove they're the best in the game.

title: Mud Madness
description:
S02 E07 — Mud Cup Meltdown
Josh needs a Hail Mary to save his season; Bryce, fighting to maintain his lead, faces difficulties in a race about speed; still reeling from his relationship drama, AJ is determined to prove himself in the final races of the Mud Cup.

title: Mud Madness
description:
S02 E08 — The $100,000 Controversy
It's the final race of the Mud Cup and four drivers are fighting for the $100,000 prize; a shocking controversy has thrown the championship into question, stunning the entire mud world.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E01 — Life, Liberty and Tax-free Liquor
Demand spikes for Tim and Tickle's duty-free shine, but big profits breed competition in the Virginia backwoods; Mark and Digger buy 90,000 bushels of surplus corn, but must run stills 24/7 to empty the grain silos in 60 days.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E02 — Stranger Danger
Tim and Tickle's tariff-dodging operation is threatened when a stranger appears at their still site; Mark and Digger face buyer's remorse over their $70K corn purchase; Jerry reaches his breaking point when Mike's $4K moonshine deal goes south.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E03 — Mine and Shine
Josh invests money he doesn't yet have to build a still site that doubles as a gold mine; Mark enlists Amanda and Kelly to distill liquor from surplus soybeans to prove Digger wrong.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E04 — Digger Knows Best
Facing more demand for corn liquor than he can handle, Josh turns to Digger for help. Tim and Tickle discover their oddball neighbor is running an illegal moonshine operation of his own.

title: Sin City Tow
description:
S01 E09 — Mutiny At TTC
Tensions run high on the streets of Las Vegas as the year comes to a close; Elmer has a blowout with his boss; Pineapple rips into a new driver over their worst tow ever; Nick deals with a raging customer.

title: Sin City Tow
description:
S01 E05 — Heartbreak Hotel
The crazies on the Strip keep the tow bros busy; TW goes toe-to-toe with an angry Elvis, and Jeremy contends with salty strip club clients while Pineapple senses déjà vu in a trucker's lot; Elmer is sent on a fool's errand.

title: Sin City Tow
description:
S01 E04 — Tricks, Treats, and Tows
A drunk man dressed like a giant baby refuses to let Shawn tow his car; a frightening find spooks Pineapple; during a call at a haunted house, the tow truck driver is terrified.

title: Sin City Tow
description:
S01 E08 — Formula One Frenzy
It's a race for the most tows as thousands of fans descend on Las Vegas for the Formula One Grand Prix; TW subdues a raunchy party while Shawn confronts a racegoer carrying a big wrench; Elmer's frustrations with The Tow Truck Company come to a head.

title: Sin City Tow
description:
S01 E07 — Bachelorette Brawl
The ladies of Vegas give the tow truck drivers a run for their money when Pineapple fends off a bevy of bachelorettes in a bus; Kyle encounters a showgirl; Shawn faces off with Goliath and scores are settled between the tow companies.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
description:
S01 E05 — Copy Cat
Officers get intelligence on a passenger heading to London carrying an illicit load; when questioned, the man says he's meeting with Braveheart; a shipment of high-end construction equipment throws up red flags when its quality looks shoddy.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
description:
S01 E06 — Does Not Compute
Officers inspect an old computer that looks like it's hiding something suspicious; a man entering with a commercial amount of Betta fish claims he's importing them for personal use, although the species is often bred for illegal fish fighting.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S03 E10 — The Beetle's Live
A shipment of cardboard packing supplies hides a lethal secret, and a laptop computer bag conceals a narcotic that even advanced technology has trouble identifying; agriculture specialists prevent a deadly pest from entering the country.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S03 E03 — Bullet Points
An elite team prepares for the extradition of a cartel Sicario, or hit man wanted for murder in his home country; with the sale of guns and ammo strictly controlled in Mexico, cartels turn to America for the weapons to wage their wars.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S05 E06 — No Secrets Allowed
A new recruit hoping for her first drug seizure strikes it lucky; an unlikely smuggler is caught with nearly $50,000 in cash; officers find a fuel tank that's got more than gas inside it; a bus is searched after a K9 alerts to a strange smell.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S04 E02 — Cocaine Chihuahua
As a man attempts to cross the border, he is flagged as having an outstanding manslaughter warrant; officers discover a secret stash of cocaine hidden inside a tractor-trailer; a woman caught with prescription pills is suspected of drug dealing.

title: All Access PD: Grand Rapids
description:
S01 E05 — The Twins
After a gunfight outside a bar ends with two dead, Grand Rapids detectives discover that twin brothers are involved; the twins claim self-defense.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E07 — Anderson County Jail
Anderson County, Tennessee, is federally recognized as an area affected by drug trafficking and gangs. With only one county jail, Sheriff Barker and his team combat crime while offering unique inmate reentry programs that reduce recidivism.
